command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$ifs=@{PE1=@('Ethernet1/0/1','Ethernet1/0/2','Ethernet2/0/0','Ethernet2/0/1');PE2=@('Ethernet1/0/0','Ethernet1/0/1','Ethernet1/0/2');PE3=@('Ethernet1/0/0','Ethernet1/0/1','Ethernet1/0/2')}; foreach(`$n in @('PE1','PE2','PE3')){ '===== '+`$n+' ====='; foreach(`$i in `$ifs[`$n]){ `$c='display interface '+`$i; `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_05/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$o=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get).output; '### '+`$i; `$o -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object { `$_ -match 'current state|Description|Internet Address|Speed|bandwidth|rate|utilization|discard|drop|error|Total' } } }"
